notes: Modified cash basis governmental funds (recorded as cash basis), accrual-basis enterprise funds. Governmental lines from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances, Total Governmental Funds column (p7; labels on p6): fund balance as originally reported 343,235 + 1,391,154 - 1,246,803 + restatement (28,832) = 458,754. No transfers. ending_cash 119,695 and ending_investments (certificates of deposit) 323,796 from the governmental funds balance sheet Total column (p5); county treasurer cash 15,263 separate; beginning cash not printed. Business-type from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Fund Net Position, Total column (p9): 2,066,786 + 853,749 - 995,799 = 1,924,736 (operating + nonoperating summed; no single printed total). Utility 'Other revenue' 8,301 is in Statement of Activities general revenues 'Miscellaneous', not Charges for Services, so it stays other. Warren Memorial Hospital support 250,000 is a nonoperating expense of the Electric Fund included in Statement of Activities expenses. proprietary from the Statement of Cash Flows Total column (p10; no noncapital financing section printed). Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds balance sheet Total column (p5; totals equal the government-wide governmental column 458,754), business-type lines from the Statement of Net Position (p1); totals are the Statement of Net Position Total column; component unit (CRA) excluded. Detail: General Fund from the departmental combining statement (pp15-16; General Fund budget schedule p11 not recorded, less detailed); Street and Debt Service budget schedules (pp12-13); nonmajor combining statement per fund (p14; CW Johnson Trust Fund has no activity). Report counts Ambulance department under Public works and Cemetery under Environment and leisure; detail keeps public safety / health/welfare as in other years. Read pages 1-16 of 16
